description: Preview a brand-spot assembly from existing project items with an optional workspace-contained MOGRT overlay. Preview is local-only; it does not read or import the MOGRT file.

approved_workspace_path.description: Operator-approved root containing mogrt_path; required whenever mogrt_path is supplied.

asset_item_ids.description: Exact existing project-item node IDs in playback order; external media paths are deliberately not imported by this workflow.

audio_track_index.description: Empty destination audio track index, default 0.

clip_duration_seconds.description: Planned spacing between asset starts; defaults to 5 seconds for a motion demo and 4 seconds for spots.

mogrt_path.description: Optional absolute .mogrt path, which must be inside approved_workspace_path.

motion_style.description: Scale-motion style for product and brand spots; defaults to alternate.

sequence_id.description: Exact ID of an existing empty destination sequence. It must be active at apply time.

title_start_seconds.description: MOGRT start time in seconds, default 0.4.

title_track_index.description: Empty title-overlay video track index, default 1 and distinct from video_track_index.

transition_duration_seconds.description: Transition duration, default 0.75 seconds for demos and 0.5 seconds for spots.

transition_name.description: Transition name; defaults to Cross Dissolve. Use none to disable transitions.

video_track_index.description: Empty destination video track index, default 0.

name: preview_brand_spot

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Preview Brand Spot
